summary: Improve hotel handovers, room readiness, guest recovery and operating controls in this five-day intermediate course. Explore the outline.
lede: Hotel operations management helps supervisors and department leads coordinate daily service across rooms, front office, housekeeping, food service and maintenance. This course supports professionals responsible for reliable shifts and room readiness, with practice in reconciling room-status exceptions, structuring staff rotas and documenting guest-recovery actions. It also covers handovers, food-service controls and maintenance work-order follow-up using hotel operating records.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits hotel professionals who already work with guests, rooms or property operations and need to coordinate daily service more consistently. It is designed for roles that manage hotel workflows directly or support their control and reporting.
modules: Hotel Shift Handover and Daily Briefing
Hotel Staffing Rota and Labor Controls
HACCP Controls in Hotel Food Service
Hotel Work Orders and Operating Review
prerequisites: Prior experience in at least one hotel department, or responsibility for hotel service workflows, is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
